info.title: Tuyan private read-only operations
info.description: Deployment candidate, disabled until configured. Aggregate observations only. Preserve source availability, sampledAt, window and definitions. Never infer DAU, lifetime totals, charges or revenue.

get.summary: Read retained account and Core job counts, not DAU or revenue

400.description: Invalid window or extra query fields

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired service credential

403.description: Missing overview:read scope or browser origin

get.summary: Read failed-job counts by fixed category, stage and request state

400.description: Invalid window or extra query fields

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired service credential

403.description: Missing failures:read scope or browser origin

get.summary: Read partial Core and existing host observations; check stale/available flags

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired service credential

403.description: Missing health:read scope or browser origin

agentBearer.description: Independent revocable operations credential from a private credential store; never an administrator session or Core transport key.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive createdAt, UTC with milliseconds (2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z). Provide both from/to or neither. At most 90 days. Default last 24 hours ending at current minute.

to.name: to
to.description: Exclusive createdAt, UTC with milliseconds. Must be after from and no later than now.

aggregate.description: Source availability is per section. Missing data is not zero; health stale is not current. See definitions in the response.
